content.title: Monastery Skate Route | Steps, Prayer-Wheel Corridor and Courtyard Jump
content.summary: An adult skateboarder crosses monastery steps, corridor and courtyard before a mural stop. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult rider, board and costume persist. + The route advances continuously through three zones. + Wheel contact proves traversal. + Exactly one jump occurs with visible landing. + The final stop preserves rider, board and destination.
quick_start.recommended_input: One original adult skateboarder begins descending three broad steps in a painted mountain monastery corridor. Follow past eight bronze prayer wheels; robe and red hat stream backward while both feet stay on the board. Roll to the central wall painting, slow once and stop with board, adult rider and full mural readable together.

The route advances continuously through three zones.

creative_dna.mechanism: 同一成年滑手以黑色长袍、红帽和固定滑板为身份锚点，从壁画阶梯下滑，贴近轮组进入转经筒长廊，再穿入庭院完成一次腾跃；终局停在佛画前，完整路线连续可追踪。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: Exactly one jump occurs with visible landing.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Exactly one jump occurs with visible landing."

invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final stop preserves rider, board and destination."
